caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large promise about making a post go “VIRAL” leads with a prominent lavender tag and a short clarification line.
visual_anatomy.layout: Three-column matrix compares empathy, debate, and resource varieties across repeated rows such as behaviour, shelf life, engagement, content, and business effect.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Promise → three category headers → top-to-bottom comparison rows → colored action pills / closing impact row.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large plain sans with rough display accent, bold category headers, and a dense table of compact labels and numerical annotations.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pink, aqua, and lavender encode the three alternatives through headers, row fills, curves, and decision pills.
visual_anatomy.surface: White, fine black table rules, flat colour fields, softly shadowed pill annotations, and simple line/area chart motifs.
visual_anatomy.modules: Three columns and seven shared row categories; several rows use small chart-like sketches instead of only text.
visual_anatomy.density: Very high: a single visual contains qualitative, time, and numeric comparisons with a fixed reader path.

motion.observed_state_change: Sampled frames show category labels, line/area marks, and pill markers arriving in stages while the row-and-column structure remains stable.
motion.motion_job: Progressively expose comparison evidence without changing the outer comparison model.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand a multi-criterion distinction between three genuinely different outcomes.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Multi-criteria comparison with mixed qualitative and quantitative rows.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Keep the column logic stable while letting the visual encoding match each row’s semantic type: text, curve, range, or action.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when numbers are sourced and comparably defined; otherwise keep the visual qualitative and name its boundary.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source “virality” taxonomy, rates, claims, curves, row labels, colour assignment, pill treatment, or title cadence.

claim_boundary.note: The visible engagement percentages, business outcomes, and format claims lack native provenance in the supplied corpus.
